title: Transition to chaos in two-dimensional Rayleigh-Bénard convection: the role of the magnetic field
summary: The impact of an externally imposed magnetic field on numerical simulations of two-dimensional Rayleigh-Bénard convection (RBC) is investigated. Initially, the RBC model is examined in the absence of a magnetic field to establish a baseline. Then, a background magnetic field is introduced, and its influence on the transition to chaos is explored. For the purely hydrodynamic case and a range of the reduced Rayleigh number, the system exhibits traveling rolls which, after an attractor-merging crisis, give way to chaotic traveling rolls.
